blocks.text: If the new complex that could form is more stable than the existing one, the ligands are substituted (exchanged). The new complex has different properties, such as colour, structure and reactivity. The complexes of copper(II) and cobalt(II) ions show ligand exchange clearly.

blocks.title: Ligand exchange
blocks.text: A ligand exchange (substitution) reaction is one in which one or more ligands in a complex are replaced by other ligands.

blocks.prompt: When does ligand exchange take place?
blocks.explanation: When the complex formed with the new ligands is more stable than the original complex.

items: Ligands are replaced when the new complex is more stable; colour and shape can change.
